name: core.openwop.workflows.it-support
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149, ADR 0208) — the IT / Support cluster: Incident Triage & Major-Incident Comms. An AI classifier assesses each incident's severity; routine incidents go to a recommended knowledge-base article and a ticket, while major incidents go to human-approved stakeholder updates in Slack — and each incident finishes with a post-incident summary. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Resolves on hosts shipping the kb + http + ai + chat + integration packs. Published under core.openwop.workflows.* (openwop-team key).
author: openwop

chains.label: Incident Triage & Major-Incident Comms
chains.description: Assesses each incident's severity, then routes routine incidents to a recommended knowledge-base article and a ticket, and major incidents to human-approved stakeholder updates in Slack — finishing with a post-incident summary.

ticketingBaseUrl.description: The tenant's ticketing instance REST base (e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net or https://acme.service-now.com). Empty ⇒ no ticket is created.

ticketProject.description: Project/queue key for the created ticket.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

slackChannel.description: Slack channel these messages post to (e.g. `#ops`).

orgId.description: The org whose knowledge base is searched. Must be the same org the collection belongs to, or nothing is found.

collectionId.description: The KB collection id to search (create via the Knowledge feature or knowledge-sync).

config.systemPrompt: Classify this IT incident's severity. 'major' = widespread outage, security incident, or SLA-breaching impact; 'routine' = single-user or low-impact. Alert: {{params.alert}}

config.title: Approve the stakeholder comms before posting

config.systemPrompt: Write a post-incident summary: timeline, impact, resolution, and follow-ups.
